name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
benefit:
##### ***Village Development***
Provision of ₹20,38,000/- per village under the Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana to bridge gaps in eight sectors including road connectivity, telecom connectivity, schools, Anganwadi Centres, health sub-centres, drinking water facilities, drainage, and solid waste management.
##### ***PVTG Development***
Financial assistance under the Pradhan Mantri PVTG Develo
_eligibility_text: ##### ***For Pre-Matric Scholarship*** - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be studying in Standard IX or X. - The applicant's parental annual income must be up to ₹2,50,000/-. ##### ***For Post-Matric Scholarship*** - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Tribe. - The applicant must be studying in Class XI or above. - The applicant's parental annual income must be up to ₹2,50,000/-. ##### ***For Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (Village Eligibility)*** - The village must have at least 50% tribal population. - The village must have a total population of at least 500 Scheduled Tribes. ##### ***For PVTG Development*** - The beneficiary must belong to a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) family or habitation. ##### ***For Eklavya Model Residential Schools*** - The applicant must be a Scheduled Tribe student seeking admission in Class VI to XII.
